outcome: Apgar scores at one and 5 min
cohort: 176 live breech births between 23 + 0 and 25 + 6 weeks gestation at a tertiary university center from 2003 to 2013
finding: Cesarean section delivery of breech infants at borderline viability was associated with a lower rate of neonatal mortality compared to vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery of breech infants at borderline viability had a protective effect on neonatal mortality compared to VD depending on the regression model utilized.
